mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_cash_out_report ( report_date, user_id, wallet_type, start_cash_out_times, start_cash_out_amt, start_cash_out_failed_times, cash_out_success_times, cash_out_success_amt, false_cash_out_times, false_cash_out_amt, manual_cash_out_times, manual_cash_out_amt, fee, channel_fee, marketer_fee ) SELECT p.proc_date, p.user_id, p.wallet_type, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS start_cash_out_times, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 1 THEN p.order_amt ELSE 0 END) AS start_cash_out_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS start_cash_out_failed_times, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cash_out_success_times, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 3 THEN p.order_amt ELSE 0 END) AS cash_out_success_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS false_cash_out_times, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 5 THEN p.order_amt ELSE 0 END) AS false_cash_out_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manual_cash_out_times, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 6 THEN p.order_amt ELSE 0 END) AS manual_cash_out_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 3 THEN p.fee ELSE 0 END) AS fee, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 3 THEN p.channel_fee ELSE 0 END) AS channel_fee, SUM(CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 3 THEN p.marketer_fee ELSE 0 END) AS marketer_fee FROM p_cash_out_proc p WHERE p.id BETWEEN #{fromId} AND #{toId} GROUP BY p.proc_date, p.user_id, p.wallet_type ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE start_cash_out_times = IFNULL(start_cash_out_times,0) + VALUES(start_cash_out_times), start_cash_out_amt = IFNULL(start_cash_out_amt,0) + VALUES(start_cash_out_amt), start_cash_out_failed_times = IFNULL(start_cash_out_failed_times,0) + VALUES(start_cash_out_failed_times), cash_out_success_times = IFNULL(cash_out_success_times,0) + VALUES(cash_out_success_times), cash_out_success_amt = IFNULL(cash_out_success_amt,0) + VALUES(cash_out_success_amt), false_cash_out_times = IFNULL(false_cash_out_times,0) + VALUES(false_cash_out_times), false_cash_out_amt = IFNULL(false_cash_out_amt,0) + VALUES(false_cash_out_amt), manual_cash_out_times = IFNULL(manual_cash_out_times,0) + VALUES(manual_cash_out_times), manual_cash_out_amt = IFNULL(manual_cash_out_amt,0) + VALUES(manual_cash_out_amt), fee = IFNULL(fee,0) + VALUES(fee), channel_fee = IFNULL(channel_fee,0) + VALUES(channel_fee), marketer_fee = IFNULL(marketer_fee,0) + VALUES(marketer_fee)
